Southwest Amarillo.name: Southwest Amarillo
Southwest Amarillo.description: Southwestern growth belt of newer subdivisions and highway-oriented retail.

Amarillo College Area.description: Campus-adjacent district and Wolflin Heights edges with steady renovation and services.
